title: Portosaur MDX Components
description: Props of the components Portosaur provides in MDX.

Btn.description: Btn — the MDX content button: a link styled as a button. A thin wrapper around the shared `Button` — the variants (primary / secondary / success / warning / danger / info / ghost), `outline`, and `sm` / `lg` sizes are OG's Button API, and the `icon` prop renders a DynamicIcon before the label. `className`, `disabled`, `onClick`, `title`, and `ariaLabel` pass straight through to the shared Button.

href.description: A full URL — external links open in a new tab.

outline.description: Outline style instead of a filled button.

size.description: Small or large. Leave unset for the default size.

icon.description: An icon id shown before the label.

sameTab.description: Keep an external link in the same tab.

Card.description: Card — one card in a `Cards` grid: a title, an optional description and icon, and an optional href that turns the whole card into a link. Children render below the description.

description.description: A short line under the title.

href.description: The link destination — with one the whole card is a link.

icon.description: An Iconify id for the icon beside the title, like `lu:rocket`.

Cards.description: Cards — an author-written grid of cards: hand-picked links or notes in the middle of a page. Unlike TopicList, which builds its cards from the page tree, these cards are written out in the MDX by hand. Each Card takes a title, an optional description, an optional icon (an Iconify id), and an optional href — with an href the whole card is a link, without one it is a plain card. Children render below the description.

Carousel.description: Carousel — one slide at a time: images, cards, or any MDX content, switched by arrows, dots, keyboard, or swipe. The slides are the children, one element each. A bare image slide shows its alt text as a caption underneath.

showDots.description: Show the dot indicators under the slides.

autoplay.description: Seconds between slides. 0 turns autoplay off.

loop.description: Wrap from the last slide back to the first.

CodeBlockTab.description: CodeBlockTab — one code panel of a CodeBlockTabs group. A descriptor only: CodeBlockTabs reads its props and never renders it.

CodeBlockTabs.description: CodeBlockTabs — the tabs Fumadocs' `remark-code-tab` generates from code fences with `tab="..."` meta (and `remark-npm` from npm commands). The plugin emits a `CodeBlockTabsList` of `CodeBlockTabsTrigger`s plus a `CodeBlockTab` per fence. This component reads that shape and renders the plain `Tabs` underneath, so code tabs share its switching, group sync, persistence, and keyboard support. The `porto-tabs--code` variant drops the panel padding — the code fills the box.

defaultValue.description: The tab open on first render.

groupId.description: Tabs with the same group stay in sync across the page.

persist.description: The plugin passes `persist` with `groupId`. Portosaur always persists grouped tabs to localStorage, so there is nothing to do with it.

CodeBlockTabsList.description: CodeBlockTabsList — the tab buttons of a CodeBlockTabs group. A descriptor only: CodeBlockTabs reads its children and never renders it.

CodeBlockTabsTrigger.description: CodeBlockTabsTrigger — one tab button in a CodeBlockTabsList. A descriptor only: CodeBlockTabs reads its props and never renders it.

Details.description: Details — native `<details>` element. The Docusaurus `<Details summary="…">` shape maps directly onto it. Styled by the prose rules in content.css.

summary.description: The text on the collapsed header.

className.description: Additional class on the details element.

Diagram.description: Diagram — renders a build-time diagram. remarkMermaid turns mermaid code fences into `<Diagram svg="..."/>`, and the Pele SVG goes straight into the page (Pele escapes diagram text and filters links and styles, and the icons come from the site's own Iconify packs). The wrapper centers the diagram (content.css).

svg.description: The rendered SVG. Set by the Mermaid plugin, not written by hand.

Dropdown.description: Dropdown — the MDX `<Dropdown>` tag: a thin wrapper around the shared Dropdown with the compact trigger, keeping OG's MDX API — `trigger` / `label`, an `items` array (`{ label, to?, href? }[]`), and `children` as the menu content when no items are given. `className`, `menuClassName`, and `triggerClassName` pass extra CSS classes through, like OG's. A click opens the menu (no hover-open — click works on touch too, where hover doesn't exist). Clicking an item or elsewhere closes it.

trigger.description: Full trigger content — a string renders as the label text.

items.description: The menu items — links, buttons and separators.

align.description: Pin the menu to the trigger's left or right edge. Centered by default.

noArrow.description: Drop the chevron on the trigger.

dropUp.description: Open the menu above the trigger instead of below it.

DynamicIcon.description: DynamicIcon — renders a frontmatter `icon` value, which may be an Iconify id, a local image path, a remote URL, or an emoji.

icon.description: The icon value — an id, an emoji, or an image source.

slug.description: Guesses an icon from the page slug when no icon is given.

fallbackIcon.description: Shown when the icon cannot be resolved.

size.description: The icon size, as a CSS length.

File.description: File — one row in a `FileTree`: an icon and a name. The icon comes from the file's extension or well-known name unless the `icon` prop gives an Iconify id.

icon.description: An Iconify id for the file icon, like `lu:file-json`. Defaults to the icon for the file's extension or name.

comment.description: A note after the name, shown muted and smaller.

FileTree.description: FileTree — a file listing for docs: folders that open and close, files as rows. The look follows Fumadocs' file tree — a bordered card, rows with an icon and a name. Nested rows join their parent with branch lines, like a drawn tree. A Folder is a native `<details>` element, so no JavaScript is involved.

Folder.description: Folder — a collapsible folder in a `FileTree`: a native `<details>` element, so no JavaScript is involved. Closed by default unless `defaultOpen` is set. Folders with children show a chevron, and the name ends with a `/`.

icon.description: An Iconify id for the folder icon. Defaults to the icon for the folder's name, or the folder glyph.

defaultOpen.description: Open the folder by default. Closed by default.

comment.description: A note after the name, shown muted and smaller.

Hint.description: Hint — simplified tooltip: the `msg` prop (the hint's content lives in the prop, not in children) renders in a tinted box above any children. OG's full portal tooltip is Phase 2 scope.

msg.description: The message shown above the content.

Icon.description: Icon — renders a single Iconify icon by id (`md:book`, `fa7-solid:font`, …) as inline SVG, from the site's generated icon map. The `:prefix:name:` shortcode in prose becomes this element (`remarkIcons`).

size.description: The icon size, as a CSS length.

IconSearch.description: IconSearch — a search field for the site's icons, with the shorthand to copy.

dropUp.description: Open the results above the field instead of below it.

Indent.description: Indent — renders children in an indented block.

Link.description: Link — the explicit `<Link href="…">` MDX tag (distinct from Markdown `[text](href)` links, which the route's `a` override handles). The component resolves the destination itself. Internal links render through Next.js `<Link>` (trailing-slashed), external ones as plain anchors opening in a new tab.

href.description: The link destination. An internal page path, a full URL, or a `#section` anchor.

Pv.description: Pv (Preview) — trigger only in Phase 1: renders as a plain link/button naming the previewed file. The viewer is Phase 2.

href.description: The link target. Without it the text renders unlinked.

host.description: The instance the repo lives on, like `git.example.com`. Required for `forgejo` and `gitea`.

Step.description: Step — one step in a `Steps` sequence: an optional title and its body as children. The number comes from the CSS counter, so steps renumber themselves when reordered.

Steps.description: Steps — a numbered sequence for guides and tutorials. Each Step takes an optional title and its body as children. The numbers come from a CSS counter, so no JavaScript is involved: the badge and the line joining the steps are both drawn in Steps.css.

TabItem.description: TabItem — one panel of a `Tabs` group. Hidden unless its `value` is the active tab. Outside a `Tabs` group (no context) it renders its children plainly.

value.description: The tab's value. Tabs are matched by it.

label.description: The label on the tab button. Falls back to the value.

attributes.description: Extra attributes on the tab button.

className.description: Extra classes on the tab panel.

Tabs.description: Tabs — a tab group: TabItem panels switched by tab buttons. Groups with the same groupId stay in sync, and queryString remembers the active tab in the URL.

defaultValue.description: The tab open on first render.

groupId.description: Tabs with the same group stay in sync across the page.

queryString.description: Remember the active tab in the URL. True uses the group id as the key.

values.description: The tabs, as value and label pairs.

block.description: Stretch the tab buttons to fill the width.

lazy.description: Render a tab's content only when it is opened.

TopicList.description: TopicList — cards linking to the page's child pages, or to the given items.

forceRender.description: Show the list even when the page would not get one automatically.

items.description: The cards to show, instead of the page's child pages.
